articles.title: Zelestra Secures $350 Million From CIBC, BBVA And Société Générale For 203 MW Reclamation Solar Project
articles.snippet:
Zelestra has closed $350 million in green financing credit facilities for its 203 MW Reclamation Solar project in Gibson County, Indiana, taking the renewable energy company's U.S. project financing raised during 2026 to $1.14 billion.
The post Zelestra Secures $350 Million From CIBC, BBVA And Société Générale For 203 MW Reclamation Solar Project appeared first on Pulse 2.0 .
articles.text:
Zelestra Secures $350 Million From CIBC, BBVA And Société Générale For 203 MW Reclamation Solar Project
By Amit Chowdhry
Oct 7, 2026
Zelestra Secures $350 Million From CIBC, BBVA And Société Générale For 203 MW Reclamation Solar Project
Zelestra has closed $350 million in green financing credit facilities for its 203 MW Reclamation Solar project in Gibson County, Indiana, taking the renewable energy company’s U.S. project financing raised during 2026 to $1.14 billion.
The financing was provided by Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce, BBVA and Société Générale, with CIBC serving as Left-Lead Arranger.
Zelestra said the more than $1 billion raised this year is supporting over 800 MW of new solar capacity currently entering construction for customers across the United States.
Reclamation Solar is backed by a long-term power purchase agreement with Meta and is expected to begin operations by the end of 2027.
The project is already under construction and is expected to support approximately 200 jobs at the peak of construction.
Reclamation takes its name from the land where it is being developed, which was reclaimed from former coal mining operations in southwest Indiana.
The financing represents another expansion of Zelestra’s U.S. platform as the company develops renewable energy projects designed around growing electricity demand from hyperscalers and other corporate customers.
Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, Zelestra currently has a development pipeline of approximately 16 GW across major U.S. markets.
KEY QUOTES:
“Passing $1 billion in US project financing this year is a milestone we are pleased to share with our lenders and our customers. Reclamation is a major project that will deliver many benefits to our customer, and to the wider community. We are pleased that CIBC, BBVA and Societe Generale are backing our ambition. These partnerships enable us to keep building at the pace this market needs.”
Sybil Milo Cioffi, U.S. CFO of Zelestra
“CIBC is pleased to have served as Left-Lead Arranger on the financing of Reclamation Solar and to support Zelestra on this important project. The transaction demonstrates our ability to deliver financing solutions for large-scale renewable energy projects and support growing power demand across the US.”
Ines Serrao, Head of U.S. Project Finance & Infrastructure at CIBC

articles.title: WTEC Secures $345 Million Credit Facility Led By Santander Bank
articles.snippet:
WTEC has secured a $345 million asset-based revolving credit facility led by Santander Bank to provide additional working capital for the company's expansion across renewable energy, grid modernization, data center and AI infrastructure markets.
The post WTEC Secures $345 Million Credit Facility Led By Santander Bank appeared first on Pulse 2.0 .
articles.text:
WTEC Secures $345 Million Credit Facility Led By Santander Bank
By Amit Chowdhry
Oct 2, 2026
WTEC Secures $345 Million Credit Facility Led By Santander Bank
WTEC has secured a $345 million asset-based revolving credit facility led by Santander Bank to provide additional working capital for the company’s expansion across renewable energy, grid modernization, data center and AI infrastructure markets.
Santander’s Commercial Bank served as administrative agent, joint lead arranger and joint bookrunner. The bank partnered with four additional banks to structure the financing.
The transaction expands a relationship between Santander and WTEC that began in 2005, when the bank provided WTEC with a $100,000 working capital line of credit.
Based in Hasbrouck Heights, New Jersey, WTEC manufactures electrical cables, wires, steel products and other infrastructure components.
The company was founded in 2002 and operates more than 12 manufacturing facilities totaling approximately 2 million square feet, according to the financing announcement.
WTEC’s broader operating footprint includes its Steel, Wires & Cables, OEM, Collection Systems, Commercial & Industrial, 4S and Torque Tube divisions.
The company plans to use the additional financial flexibility to continue investing in U.S. manufacturing, innovation and customer service while supporting growth across energy, utility and data center markets.
KEY QUOTES:
“We’re proud to deepen our partnership with WTEC as the company continues to expand its manufacturing footprint and meet growing demand. Supporting ambitious middle-market companies like WTEC is central to our strategy, and we’re excited to help position them for their next chapter of growth.”
Ellen Marshall, Head of Corporate & Middle Market Banking at Santander
“As Lead Bank, we’re honored by the long-term relationship we’ve built with the WTEC team. We look forward to continuing our partnership as the company executes on its strategic objectives and expands its market share across the energy and infrastructure sectors.”
Anthony Selvaggio, Head of New York and New Jersey Corporate & Middle Market Banking at Santander
“The expansion of our credit facility reflects the strength of WTEC, LLC’s business platform and the trust we have built with Santander over many years. This additional financial flexibility supports our continued investment in U.S. manufacturing, innovation, and customer service across the renewable energy, utility, infrastructure, and rapidly growing data center markets. We appreciate Santander’s partnership and confidence in WTEC’s future.”
Bonita Singh, Chief Financial Officer of WTEC

articles.title: Pilot Fiber Raises Over $330 Million Led By Fengate And Agrees To Acquire Boldyn Networks’ New York And New Jersey Fiber Business
articles.snippet:
Pilot Fiber, an enterprise connectivity provider serving the New York metropolitan area, has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire the New York and New Jersey metro fiber business of Boldyn Networks.
The post Pilot Fiber Raises Over $330 Million Led By Fengate And Agrees To Acquire Boldyn Networks’ New York And New Jersey Fiber Business appeared first on Pulse 2.0 .
articles.text:
Pilot Fiber Raises Over $330 Million Led By Fengate And Agrees To Acquire Boldyn Networks’ New York And New Jersey Fiber Business
By Amit Chowdhry
Oct 22, 2026
Pilot Fiber Raises Over $330 Million Led By Fengate And Agrees To Acquire Boldyn Networks’ New York And New Jersey Fiber Business
Pilot Fiber, an enterprise connectivity provider serving the New York metropolitan area, has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire the New York and New Jersey metro fiber business of Boldyn Networks.
To support the acquisition and its continued expansion, Pilot also announced more than $330 million in new financing led by Fengate Asset Management.
The transactions are expected to close during the second quarter of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.
The acquisition will significantly expand Pilot’s regional fiber network, extending its owned infrastructure across all five boroughs of New York City and into additional markets throughout New Jersey.
Following completion, Pilot expects its combined owned network to encompass more than 1,600 route miles of fiber, connecting over 1,200 buildings and 50 data centers.
The transaction is Pilot’s second acquisition of 2026, following its purchase of Extenet’s enterprise fiber business in August.
Boldyn’s assets include a New York City fiber network supporting data center connectivity, smart city infrastructure, and enterprise telecommunications services, along with a New Jersey network serving commercial businesses and carriers.
The New Jersey portion of the acquired infrastructure includes more than 860 route miles of fiber, with established connectivity across commercial corridors serving financial services, healthcare, and other industries.
The acquisition will also expand Pilot’s reach into Brooklyn through a dedicated East River crossing and provide additional infrastructure across Queens, the Bronx, Staten Island, and portions of the region extending toward Nassau County.
Other assets include monopole infrastructure supporting low-latency connectivity between major financial exchanges.
The acquired business currently serves approximately 100 enterprise, carrier, and institutional customers.
Pilot plans to integrate these customers into its existing operations and offer its full portfolio of connectivity services across the expanded network.
The company’s services include Dedicated Internet Access, Ethernet Transport, Dark Fiber, Wavelength, and IP Transit, serving organizations requiring high-capacity and reliable network infrastructure.
Pilot emphasizes direct ownership of its fiber network and in-house operations as central components of its service model.
The company reports that its installation process for on-network buildings typically requires five to 15 days, compared with an industry standard of approximately 30 to 90 days.
Fengate Asset Management is providing its equity investment through Fengate Infrastructure Fund V.
Warren Roll, Fengate’s managing director and head of digital infrastructure, is leading the investment and will join Pilot’s board of directors.
Fengate is an alternative investment manager focused on infrastructure, private equity, and real estate, with investments across digital infrastructure, transportation, energy transition, and related sectors.
The new financing will support Pilot’s acquisition strategy as it expands its network ownership and enterprise connectivity capabilities.

articles.title: Lydian Energy Secures $300 Million Credit Facility From Infranity
articles.snippet:
Lydian Energy closed a $300 million holding company credit facility with Infranity to accelerate development of utility-scale battery energy storage and renewable energy projects. The financing will support development, construction, acquisition, and operation of Lydian's portfolio of battery storage and solar projects. Lydian is backed by Excelsior Energy Capital.
The post Lydian Energy Secures $300 Million Credit Facility From Infranity appeared first on Pulse 2.0 .
articles.text:
Lydian Energy Secures $300 Million Credit Facility From Infranity
By Amit Chowdhry
Oct 11, 2026
Lydian Energy Secures $300 Million Credit Facility From Infranity
Lydian Energy closed a $300 million holding company credit facility with Infranity to accelerate development of utility-scale battery energy storage and renewable energy projects. The financing will support development, construction, acquisition, and operation of Lydian’s portfolio of battery storage and solar projects. Lydian is backed by Excelsior Energy Capital.
Founded in 2023, the company has built a portfolio totaling approximately 6 gigawatts of operating, construction-ready, and development-stage projects across the U.S.
The facility is structured to allow Lydian to leverage the value of operating and construction-ready assets while retaining ownership of projects that can generate long-term value.
The financing also provides additional flexibility to advance projects from development through construction as electricity demand and grid modernization accelerate.
Akin Gump served as legal counsel to Lydian.
Eversheds Sutherland represented Infranity.
Infranity manages approximately €15 billion in assets on behalf of institutional investors.
Excelsior Energy Capital closed its second fund at slightly more than $1 billion in 2025 after raising $504 million for its first flagship fund in 2020.
KEY QUOTES:
“Closing this facility is an important milestone for Lydian.”
Emre Ersenkal, CEO of Lydian Energy
“The transaction is underpinned by a portfolio of high-quality contracted projects and a strong pipeline of energy infrastructure assets developed and owned by Lydian.”
Sacha Kamp, Global Head of Debt Investment at Infranity
“It gives Lydian efficient, scalable capital to grow its portfolio as demand for reliable, domestically produced power continues to rise.”
Chris Moakley, Managing Partner at Excelsior Energy Capital and Chair of Lydian Energy

articles.title: Atom Computing Advances To Final Stage Of DARPA Quantum Benchmarking Initiative
articles.snippet:
Atom Computing was selected by the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency to advance to the final stage of DARPA’s Quantum Benchmarking Initiative. Stage C of the program carries potential funding of up to $300 million.
The post Atom Computing Advances To Final Stage Of DARPA Quantum Benchmarking Initiative appeared first on Pulse 2.0 .
articles.text:
Atom Computing Advances To Final Stage Of DARPA Quantum Benchmarking Initiative
By Amit Chowdhry
Oct 8, 2026
Atom Computing Advances To Final Stage Of DARPA Quantum Benchmarking Initiative
Atom Computing was selected by the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency to advance to the final stage of DARPA’s Quantum Benchmarking Initiative. Stage C of the program carries potential funding of up to $300 million.
The Quantum Benchmarking Initiative is evaluating whether utility-scale quantum computers can be built on a faster timeline than conventional industry expectations.
Atom Computing was selected for Stage A in early 2025 and advanced to Stage B later that year.
During Stage B, the company developed a detailed plan for building a utility-scale quantum computer, including technology milestones, risk assessments, mitigation strategies, and prototype systems.
During Stage C, an independent government verification and validation team will evaluate whether Atom Computing’s proposed system can be built and operated as designed.
Microsoft has also agreed to provide algorithmic support and error correction codes to Atom Computing as part of the effort.
Atom Computing develops quantum systems based on neutral-atom technology.
The company has demonstrated systems exceeding 1,000 physical qubits and said it has achieved sub-threshold performance with end-to-end quantum error correction across multiple rounds.
In 2025, Atom Computing completed what it described as the industry’s first commercial sale of a logical-qubit quantum computer to QuNorth.
The company also recently signed a letter of intent with the U.S. Department of Commerce involving $100 million.
KEY QUOTES:
“We believe utility-scale quantum computing is closer than many expect, and this milestone reinforces our confidence in the scalability and performance of neutral-atom architectures.”
Dr. Ben Bloom, CEO and Founder of Atom Computing
“Atom Computing’s neutral-atom architecture, combined with its demonstrated progress toward fault-tolerant quantum computing, positions the company at the forefront of delivering practical quantum systems capable of addressing some of the world’s most complex computational challenges.”
Dr. Jonathan King, Chief Scientist and Co-Founder of Atom Computing

articles.title: Canyon Partners Provides NZ$300 Million Financing For Advent International’s NZCR Investment
articles.snippet:
Canyon Partners has arranged and anchored NZ$300 million of financing supporting Advent International's acquisition of NZCR Group, a clinical trials and medical research organization operating across New Zealand and Australia.
The post Canyon Partners Provides NZ$300 Million Financing For Advent International’s NZCR Investment appeared first on Pulse 2.0 .
articles.text:
Canyon Partners Provides NZ$300 Million Financing For Advent International’s NZCR Investment
By Amit Chowdhry
Oct 5, 2026
Canyon Partners Provides NZ$300 Million Financing For Advent International’s NZCR Investment
Canyon Partners has arranged and anchored NZ$300 million of financing supporting Advent International’s acquisition of NZCR Group, a clinical trials and medical research organization operating across New Zealand and Australia. Canyon served as arranger and anchor lender for the financing.
NZCR is a physician-led clinical research organization with more than 35 years of research experience across early- and later-stage clinical studies.
Headquartered in Auckland, the company operates across Australia and New Zealand and works with biotechnology and pharmaceutical sponsors.
The financing will support Advent’s investment and NZCR’s next phase of growth.
Advent plans to work with the existing management team to expand NZCR’s capabilities across the clinical trial spectrum, strengthen relationships with sponsors and contract research organizations and increase the company’s international reach.
Canyon said its investment thesis is supported by continued expansion of the Australia and New Zealand clinical research market and NZCR’s position with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies globally.
The transaction also extends Canyon’s relationship with Advent and expands its financing activity supporting transactions sourced through Advent’s Australian office.
Canyon manages approximately $30 billion across public and private corporate credit, asset-backed credit and real estate strategies.
KEY QUOTES:
“We are excited to support NZCR’s continued development and to work again with Advent, whose deep sector expertise and strong track record of partnering with management teams make them an ideal fit for the business. It’s our pleasure to leverage our capabilities as a global investment firm to support Advent on deals originated from their new Australian office and be a reliable financing partner in the ANZ market as we long have in the United States, Europe and beyond.”
Davide Amico, Partner and Co-Head of Private Credit at Canyon
“NZCR has built a strong platform with meaningful growth momentum, and we see significant opportunity as the ANZ market continues to attract an increasing share of global clinical trial activity. We are pleased to support Advent as they bring their expertise to this next stage of growth, working alongside existing management to help the business capitalize on these opportunities.”
Maximilian Lichtenheld, Managing Director at Canyon
“Advent has been following NZCR Group’s success and growth for over 18 months, and we continue to be impressed by the quality of the platform, its clinical leadership, and the trust it has built with biopharma and biotech clients. We look forward to partnering with management and existing shareholders to unlock NZCR Group’s full potential and introduce the business into Advent’s global network. We see exceptional opportunities to build on NZCR Group’s strengths while preserving the clinical focus that underpins its success.”
Beau Dixon, Managing Director and Head of Australia and New Zealand at Advent International
